title: Oil & Gas Lease Buyer (TX)
job_description:
Company Overview
NorthStar Energy is a Denver, CO based full land and mineral services firm committed to delivering industry-leasing service and expertise to our clients.

Job Description

NorthStar Energy is seeking effective oil and gas lease buyers with at least 3 years of experience acquiring leases in TX.

Responsibilities:

Negotiate and acquire oil and gas leases.
Prepare lease packets from title provided and records research.
Track and detail correspondence in weekly updates.
Review and confirm accuracy of executed documents.
Identify and obtain necessary curative documents.

Requirements:

Minimum of 3 years proven experience of acquiring oil and gas leases in TX. Must outline work history timelines and areas worked on resume.
Ability to build relationships with mineral owners.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly organized and available to discuss status of negotiations at all times.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to navigate various databases.
Provide support and assistance to Project Manage and Administrative Staff to ensure project directives are met.

Preferred Qualifications:

AAPL Membership.
JD, CPL or RPL.
Degreen in Energy Management or Petroleum Land Management.
Bachelor’s Degree.

Compensation:

Day rates are based on performance and experience.

Start Date:

As soon as possible.

Experience:

negotiating and acquiring oil and gas leases in TX: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
